label: Hightop Van
generated: measured off the rig source by hand-transcription with per-value provenance; no generator in the rig

frame.origin: ground-centre of the body footprint (bumpers excluded from the centring; z=0 is the road)
frame.at_rest: every value here is at susF=susR=0, all leaves shut, HIGH roof, panel build. See VARIANTS for what moves.

pivot_px._note: model z=0 projects to the pivot row in all 8 facings

VARIANTS._what: two BUILD variants live in the one body. They are geometry, not poses — decide them at spawn, not per frame.

roof._note: every published top-of-van z rides this choice; the pivot, cell and everything below the belt do not

windows.false: panel van: blind sides, full bulkhead at y 0.58, bare cargo bay
windows.true: passenger van: set-in side glass, glazed slide and barn doors, TWO bench rows in the bay, NO bulkhead — the cab and bay are one room

collider_bbox._note: front arch bulges, not mirrors; z top 2.46 on roof:'low'. Add 0.17 m per side if the mirrors must be solid (glass at z 1.46..1.74).

ground_clearance_m._note: mudflaps are rubber — sweep them, do not collide them

BODY.provenance: BODIES.hightopVan + G; mirrors from buildDoorsF box |1.16..1.26|

CAB._what: a seated crew compartment on a FLAT floor shared with the bay. On windows:true there is no wall behind it at all.

floor.provenance: buildInterior cargo slab runs to y 0.56; the cab shares its level — one flat floor nose to tail

bulkhead._note: full-height, no pass-through. windows:true deletes it — cab and bay become one walkable room.

clear_between_tubs._note: a 1.24 m aisle for the metre the tubs span; full 1.88 m fore and aft of them (panel build — the benches sit ON the tub span in the passenger build)

keep_clear._note: sweep of the free edge about the hinge axis; the collider is the arc, not the leaf

boarding._note: no running board is modelled — the 0.52 m step-in is bare

reach_point._note: outside the swept disc; NOT tested against ground colliders

keep_clear._note: sweep of the free edge about the hinge axis

reach_point._note: outside the swept disc; NOT tested against ground colliders

motion.rule: pops out over the first 10% of the pose, then runs aft along the track at z 1.30..1.36

keep_clear._note: no swept arc — a 0.12 m strip along the body covers the pop-out and the parked leaf. The door never leaves the side.

boarding._note: the sill IS the cargo floor — kerb loading, one step

THRESHOLD.swing_sense: CW seen from above (out and aft)

keep_clear._note: quarter-disc aft of the tail per leaf; both leaves open want the full 1.96 m square behind the van

THRESHOLD.provenance: buildBarn hinge (sx*0.98, G.tailY); a = sx*pose*96deg; head = roofZ - G.barnDrop

THRESHOLD.swing_sense: CCW seen from above (out and aft)

STEP._note: NO running boards exist on this body, stowed or optional. Step-ins are bare: 0.52 m at the front doors, 0.55 m at the slide (the floor), 0.50 m at the barn sill.

hitch.provenance: buildFrame hitch block + tube [0,-3.08,0.42]->[0,-3.08,0.52]; anchors().hitch is the same point

TOW._note: one ball, no pintle, no fifth wheel, and NO front recovery points are modelled — the bumper is plastic cladding.

SUSPENSION.applies_to: the whole body group (shell, doors, slide, barn leaves, hood, hitch, mirrors) — the wheels do NOT move
SUSPENSION.consequence: every polygon in CAB, CARGO, THRESHOLD and TOW rides that dz; t extrapolates past both axles so the bumpers pitch further than the travel.

WHEELS._note: roll is per-wheel (wFL..wRR, REVOLUTIONS) on top of the master roll. One revolution closes the hubs exactly and the tread to 0.06% of painted pixels (23.81 stripes per turn) — seamless in motion, not bit-exact.
WHEELS.provenance: G.frontWX / rearWX / axF / axR / wheelR / tireW — exact

STEERING.sense: +1 = full LEFT lock; the nose swings toward -x
STEERING.ackermann: outer = atan(1/(1/tan(inner) + track/wheelbase)), front track 1.64 m, wheelbase 3.96 m
STEERING.axis: vertical, through each front wheel centre — no kingpin offset, caster or scrub radius is modelled

turning_radius_m._note: geometric, at full lock, from the published Ackermann angles. No slip, no load transfer.

swept_envelope._note: at full lock a front tire corner stands 0.066 m proud of the body but 0.014 m INSIDE the arch bulges — the bulges are the collider width and the lock is capped at 24 deg to keep it that way.

STEERING.does_not: yaw the van. STEERING turns the wheels; YAW turns the machine. A turning van wants both.

YAW.what: heading between the eight facings. The model turns about z before projection under a FIXED key, so the shading is rebaked for the new heading — this is not a rotated sprite.
YAW.pivot: unaffected; the origin projects to the published pivot at any yaw
YAW.frame: yaw is a RENDER param, not geometry. Every metre in this file is in the machine frame and does not move with it.
YAW.gameplay: a heading is dir*45 + yaw. Colliders, reach points and seat refs rotate with the machine as they always did; nothing here needs a yaw correction.

exhaust_tip._note: curb side, aft — smoke/heat FX attach

fuel_tank._note: the tank is modelled; the filler neck is not (see _excluded)

engine_bay._note: a real bay under the stub hood — a repair/jump interaction has something to look at

slide_track._note: the visible rail the curb door runs on

roof._note: rack/ladder attach; z 2.42 and the area runs to y 1.15 on roof:'low'. No rack is modelled.

_interact_notes.reach_point: a request, not a promise — a ground-level standing spot derived from which face the item is on. NOT validated against terrain, kerb or another vehicle.
_interact_notes.visible_facings: the near-side test paint() uses: a feature with outward normal n is listed for facing d when nx*sin(d*45) + ny*cos(d*45) < -0.3, edge-on excluded. Top faces are visible at all eight.

_excluded.CLEATS: not a hull. The ball is in TOW; it is a coupling point, not mooring.
_excluded.walkable_roof: a 1.80 x 3.81 m panel at z 2.72 (2.42 low) with no rack, no rail and no route up. Omitted rather than published as a surface.
_excluded.fuel_fill: no filler neck, cap or door is modelled anywhere on the body. The tank is in ATTACH.fuel_tank.
_excluded.plate_and_wipers: no licence plate, wipers, aerial or decals. At 32 px/m they are 1-3 px and were left out of the bake.
_excluded.interior_INTERACT: nothing inside is an interactable — no glovebox, radio or handbrake in the rig.
_excluded.sled_step: no side step or kerb step under the slide door — the 0.55 m floor IS the step.

_confirm.cargo_walkable: CARGO.floor is a 1.88 x 3.38 m rubber sole 0.55 m up under 2.03 m of headroom (1.73 low roof). Whether a player walks it (vs. it being a container) is unruled. It is published as geometry either way.
_confirm.bench_occupancy: each bench is one undivided 1.60 m cushion (windows:true only). Rider count and slot spacing are gameplay's call.
_confirm.bulkhead_rule: the bulkhead exists ONLY on the panel build. A game that lets a driver climb into the bay must either spawn windows:true or accept that the panel van blocks the route at y 0.58.
_confirm.mirror_collider: BODY.collider_bbox stops at the arch bulges (2.18 m). The mirrors reach 2.52 m over — decide before a mirror clips a doorframe.
_confirm.roof_variant_zs: barn head_z, roof attach z, headroom and height_m all ride the roof variant. Nothing in this file is pre-shifted; the variant blocks give both values.
_confirm.reach_points: six reach points, none tested against a ground collider or against each other.
_confirm.steering_and_yaw: STEERING moves the wheels only; YAW moves the machine. Nothing couples them — a game that turns the wheels without yawing (or the reverse) will look wrong, and the rig will not stop it.
